description: The five fixture VCFs converted once per sample profile, committed so the demonstrator and its tests run without Docker.
command: vcf_rdfizer.py --mode full --input <dir of P00*.vcf> --sample-representation {expanded|condensed} --representations none --rdf-storage-mode plain --rdf-compression gzip --image ecrum19/vcf-rdfizer --image-version 3.1.0 --no-build
